## Problem and result

Explain the problem this change addresses and what a user will observe afterward.
Link the related issue, if there is one.

## Change

Describe the implementation and any effect on task files, existing clients,
installation, or documented behavior. For a visible change, include a small preview.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Use invented data and temporary
settings. For documentation-only changes, describe the link, command, or rendering
checks instead of adding tests that only repeat the text.

## Review notes

- Note compatibility or migration concerns, or write “none”.
- Identify copied or adapted material and preserve its source and license notices.
- Confirm that private task data, credentials, chats, and installation snapshots are absent.
- If you used a coding assistant, review and understand the submitted change and verify its behavior.

English, 简体中文, and 한국어 are welcome.
